# Find A Walk-On

> UK paintball hub for finding walk-on events, browsing teams, and planning field layouts.

Find A Walk-On helps UK paintballers discover walk-on events across the country, explore the team directory, and design or share field layouts. All events are manually verified and .68 caliber only. Dates use DD/MM/YYYY and times use the 24-hour clock.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse and filter upcoming UK walk-on paintball events on a map, calendar, or list.
- [Teams](/teams): Directory of UK paintball teams with profiles, rosters, and CPPS data.
- [Field Layout](/field-layout): Interactive 2D/3D paintball field simulator and layout designer.

## Optional

- [Reset password](/reset-password): Account password recovery flow.
